examples.text: Kids need plenty of practice deploying effective organizational skills, such as managing time and setting priorities.
examples.translation: 孩子们需要大量练习有效的组织技能，例如管理时间和确定优先事项。

examples.text: They suffer from a number of genetic diseases, such as breast cancer.
examples.translation: 他们患有多种遗传性疾病，例如乳腺癌。

examples.text: They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse.
examples.translation: 他们往往会把钱包捂得更紧。

examples.text: Beethoven's music tends to move from chaos to order.
examples.translation: 贝多芬的音乐往往从混乱走向秩序。

examples.text: According to several studies, single parents are the least happy of all.
examples.translation: 根据几项研究，单亲父母是所有群体中幸福感最低的。

examples.text: According to the World Social Science Report 2010, the number of social-science students worldwide has swollen by about 11% every year since 2000.
examples.translation: 根据《2010年世界社会科学报告》，自2000年以来，全球社会科学专业学生人数每年增长约11%。

examples.text: Hill's pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts.
examples.translation: 希尔施加的压力后来促成了国家公园和绿化带的建立。

examples.text: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
examples.translation: 要求公司把性别作为董事会成员的首要资格，必然会导致私营部门董事会经验不足。

examples.text: It is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy.
examples.translation: 决定买什么的是买方，而不是卖方。

examples.text: Rather than dismissing ourselves as unchangeable creatures of habit, we can consciously develop new habits.
examples.translation: 我们不应把自己看成无法改变的习惯动物，而可以有意识地培养新习惯。

examples.text: Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for inventions that are obvious.
examples.translation: 例如，去年四月，法官们表示，太多显而易见的“发明”仍获得了专利保护。

examples.text: Johnson & Johnson, for example, has created BabyCenter.
examples.translation: 例如，强生公司创建了 BabyCenter。

examples.text: Many historians have begun to focus on the role slavery played in the lives of the founding generation.
examples.translation: 许多历史学家开始关注奴隶制在建国一代生活中所扮演的角色。

examples.text: This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk.
examples.translation: 这使美国运输安全管理局能够把注意力集中在风险更高的旅客身上。

meanings.grammar: as well as + 比较对象

examples.text: There are also stories about Sandra Bullock, as well as the usual celebrity news.
examples.translation: 此外还有关于桑德拉·布洛克的报道，以及常见的名人新闻。

examples.text: Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.
examples.translation: 这种方法既能推动新的研究，也能催生有感染力的艺术作品。

examples.text: It will read only as well as the thinking and writing that have gone into it.
examples.translation: 它读起来的质量只会和其中投入的思考与写作一样好。

examples.text: [A] as well as [B] by way of [C] on behalf of [D] with regard to
examples.translation: 完形填空

meanings.text: 至少；起码；无论如何至少

examples.text: Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.
examples.translation: 几乎每周都至少有一位明星妈妈或准妈妈微笑着出现在报刊摊上。

examples.text: In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced.
examples.translation: 在互联网时代，至少从理论上说，这一比例可以大幅降低。

examples.text: In fact, all of these cultural developments occurred separately at different times in many parts of the world.
examples.translation: 事实上，所有这些文化发展都曾在世界许多地区于不同时间各自发生。

examples.text: In fact, they go beyond how I do my work; they actually help guide how I live.
examples.translation: 事实上，它们的影响不止于我的工作方式，还真正帮助指导我的生活。

examples.text: Instead of a plan of action, they continue to press for more research.
examples.translation: 他们没有制定行动方案，而是继续要求开展更多研究。

examples.text: They created an entirely new system of ride-hailing instead of better dispatch and better directions.
examples.translation: 他们没有仅仅改进调度和导航，而是创建了一套全新的网约车系统。

examples.text: None of this will be easy, but you can start even if others refuse to.
examples.translation: 这些事情都不容易，但即使别人拒绝行动，你也可以先开始。

examples.text: These gaps can lead to lower grades for students from poorer schools, even if they have the potential to succeed in college.
examples.translation: 这些差距可能使来自条件较差学校的学生成绩更低，即使他们具备在大学取得成功的潜力。

examples.text: Battles increasingly depended on new military technologies such as radar and the proximity fuze.
examples.translation: 战争越来越依赖雷达和近炸引信等新军事技术。

examples.text: For each contact, assign a score indicating how much you depend on them.
examples.translation: 给每位联系人打分，以表示你对他们的依赖程度。

examples.text: Depending on the comments received, the editor would accept the paper for publication or decline it.
examples.translation: 编辑会根据收到的意见决定接受论文发表还是拒稿。

examples.text: The final grade is based on the quality of the portfolio as a whole.
examples.translation: 最终成绩以整个作品集的质量为依据。

examples.text: The model allows anyone to create impressive images based on text prompts.
examples.translation: 该模型允许任何人根据文本提示生成令人印象深刻的图像。

examples.text: He has failed to understand that monarchies have largely survived because they provide a service as non-controversial and non-political heads of state.
examples.translation: 他未能理解，君主制之所以大体延续下来，是因为君主作为无争议、非政治性的国家元首发挥了一定作用。

examples.text: The international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
examples.translation: 国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展。

meanings.grammar: have a vested interest in doing

examples.text: An interest in the relationship between the function of society and culture became a major theme in European anthropology.
examples.translation: 对社会功能与文化之间关系的兴趣成为欧洲人类学的一个重要主题。

examples.text: As late as 2020 research interest in AI was declining.
examples.translation: 直到 2020 年，研究界对人工智能的兴趣仍在下降。

examples.text: A multibillion-pound global industry with a vested interest in stoking your hunger.
examples.translation: 一个在刺激你的消费欲望方面拥有既得利益的数十亿英镑规模的全球产业。

examples.text: Databases used by some companies don't rely on data collected systematically.
examples.translation: 一些公司使用的数据库并不依赖系统收集的数据。

examples.text: Nearly three-quarters of Gen Zs in America have relied on influencers to help them choose products to buy.
examples.translation: 美国近四分之三的 Z 世代曾依靠网络红人帮助自己挑选商品。

examples.text: [A] adapting to [B] deriving from [C] relying on [D] pointing at
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Britain's Labor Party has long been associated with trade unionism.
examples.translation: 英国工党长期以来一直与工会主义联系在一起。

examples.text: Habitual behaviour emerges in response to dopamine, a chemical associated with pleasure.
examples.translation: 习惯性行为会在多巴胺的作用下出现，而多巴胺是一种与愉悦感相关的化学物质。

examples.text: The reason, of course, is that costs have rocketed and ticket prices have stayed low.
examples.translation: 原因当然是成本飙升，而票价却一直维持在低位。

examples.text: Of course, introverts are equally capable of experiencing passion as extroverts.
examples.translation: 当然，内向者和外向者一样能够感受到激情。

examples.text: The advent of electronic publishing resulted in thousands of new journals.
examples.translation: 电子出版的出现催生了数以千计的新期刊。

examples.text: Deforestation results in erosion and silts up rivers.
examples.translation: 森林砍伐会导致水土流失，并使河流淤塞。

meanings.grammar: end up + doing / adj. / prep. phrase

examples.text: You may even end up with several entire versions of the paper.
examples.translation: 你最后甚至可能得到好几个完整版本的论文。

examples.text: When sprinters are told to accelerate to their 100% level too soon, they end up running a slower race overall.
examples.translation: 如果短跑运动员过早被要求加速到百分之百，结果反而会使整场比赛跑得更慢。

examples.text: [A] follow up [B] pick up [C] open up [D] end up
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: We now know that basking in the dark can contribute to better health.
examples.translation: 我们现在知道，置身黑暗环境有助于改善健康。

examples.text: We strongly believe in how much our work can contribute to restoration and also help combat climate change.
examples.translation: 我们坚信自己的工作能够为生态恢复作出很大贡献，并帮助应对气候变化。

examples.text: A recent study even suggests it may contribute to the development of Alzheimer's disease.
examples.translation: 最近一项研究甚至表明，它可能促成阿尔茨海默病的发展。

examples.text: Americans no longer expect public figures to command the English language with skill and gift.
examples.translation: 美国人已经不再期待公众人物能够熟练而有才华地驾驭英语。

examples.text: That is no longer a problem, because there are fewer sharks around now.
examples.translation: 那已经不再是个问题，因为如今周围的鲨鱼更少了。

examples.text: A Formula 1 racing car, for instance, may have more than 250 sensors updating its digital twin during a grand prix.
examples.translation: 例如，一辆一级方程式赛车在大奖赛期间可能有250多个传感器持续更新其数字孪生。

examples.text: For instance, in a study that asked adolescents in Australia to answer the question 'Where are you from?'
examples.translation: 例如，在一项研究中，研究人员让澳大利亚的青少年回答“你来自哪里？”这一问题。

examples.text: [A] To be fair [B] For instance [C] To be brief [D] In general
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Alternative grading models aim to give students a better chance to demonstrate their potential, regardless of past academic challenges.
examples.translation: 替代性评分模式旨在让学生有更好的机会展示潜力，而不受以往学业困难的影响。

examples.text: This is true regardless of whether we are talking about visual, musical, mathematical, or even moral beauty.
examples.translation: 无论我们谈论的是视觉美、音乐美、数学美，甚至道德美，这一点都成立。

examples.text: In 2021, we had a shortage of all kinds of computer chips due to a perfect storm of factors.
examples.translation: 2021年，由于多种因素共同作用，各类计算机芯片都出现了短缺。

examples.text: A lot of people in rural areas have had health issues due to pesticide use.
examples.translation: 许多农村地区的人因使用农药而出现了健康问题。

examples.text: Google's Chrome is due to do so this year.
examples.translation: 谷歌 Chrome 浏览器预计今年也会这样做。

examples.text: The African savanna elephant, also known as the African bush elephant, is distributed across 37 African countries.
examples.translation: 非洲草原象，也称非洲丛林象，分布在37个非洲国家。

examples.text: Repetition helps persuade people that something is correct, a phenomenon known as the illusory truth effect.
examples.translation: 重复会使人更容易相信某件事是正确的，这种现象被称为“虚假真相效应”。

meanings.text: 获得或使用……的机会、权利或渠道

senses.gloss: 获得或使用……的机会、权利或渠道

examples.text: Students from underfunded schools may lack access to textbooks, AP courses, or other resources.
examples.translation: 来自经费不足学校的学生可能无法获得教材、AP课程或其他资源。

examples.text: Restaurants have access to premium ingredients and specialized equipment.
examples.translation: 餐馆能够获得优质食材并使用专业设备。

examples.text: Mental health is the seed that contains self-esteem, confidence in ourselves and an ability to trust in our common sense.
examples.translation: 心理健康是孕育自尊、自信以及相信自身判断力的基础。

examples.text: How intolerance of uncertainty affects our mental health.
examples.translation: 对不确定性的难以容忍会如何影响我们的心理健康。

examples.text: The Indiana Department of Mental Health.
examples.translation: 印第安纳州精神卫生部门。

examples.text: Mark Baldassare points out that much of the state's budget is patrolled by unions.
examples.translation: 马克·巴尔达萨雷指出，该州预算的很大一部分受到工会的严密影响。

examples.text: It's worth pointing out that we don't need to be particularly talented in a given artistic field to benefit from it.
examples.translation: 值得指出的是，我们并不需要在某个艺术领域特别有天赋，也能从中受益。

examples.text: Researchers examined several factors related to animal companionship.
examples.translation: 研究人员考察了几个与动物陪伴有关的因素。

examples.text: This decreasing efficiency is potentially related to this incredible moment of learning.
examples.translation: 这种效率下降可能与这一非同寻常的学习阶段有关。

examples.text: Losses must be recognized and dealt with.
examples.translation: 损失必须得到承认并加以处理。

examples.text: The threat from a crackdown on processed foods ... will be trickier to deal with.
examples.translation: 针对加工食品的严厉整治所带来的威胁将更难应对。

examples.text: Self-interest would lead them to deal with it.
examples.translation: 自身利益会促使他们与这个机构打交道。

examples.text: In dealing with the young, the fact of association itself gains in importance.
examples.translation: 在对待年轻人时，交往本身这一事实变得更加重要。

examples.text: These team members often have an outsized impact on a team's performance.
examples.translation: 这些团队成员往往会对团队表现产生格外重大的影响。

examples.text: Adding more exercise to their routine has a positive impact on well-being.
examples.translation: 在日常生活中增加锻炼会对幸福感产生积极影响。

examples.text: Social scientists who complain about a lack of funding should not expect more.
examples.translation: 抱怨资金不足的社会科学家不应指望获得更多资助。

examples.text: A lack of social connection can have negative consequences for both our mental and physical health.
examples.translation: 缺乏社会联系会对我们的身心健康造成负面影响。

examples.text: Boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure.
examples.translation: 董事会迫于股东压力而仔细审查继任计划。

examples.text: Habitual behaviour emerges in response to dopamine.
examples.translation: 习惯性行为会对多巴胺产生反应而出现。

examples.text: That was in part a crucial response to devastating famines.
examples.translation: 这在一定程度上是应对毁灭性饥荒的一项关键举措。

examples.text: In addition, the computer programs a company uses may be patented.
examples.translation: 此外，公司所使用的计算机程序可能受到专利保护。

examples.text: In addition to being a major tourism draw, lemurs are essential seed dispersers and pollinators.
examples.translation: 狐猴除了是重要的旅游吸引物之外，还是不可或缺的种子传播者和传粉者。

examples.text: Streets were full of new numbers of cars in addition to delivery wagons, bustling crowds, bicycles, horse-drawn carriages, and street cars.
examples.translation: 街道上除了送货马车、熙攘的人群、自行车、马车和有轨电车之外，还出现了大量汽车。

examples.text: [A] On the basis of [B] At the cost of [C] In addition to [D] In contrast to
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: A search for universal principles has characterized the scientific enterprise.
examples.translation: 对普遍原理的探寻一直是科学事业的一个特征。

examples.text: He tried searching for his name to see if a piece he had worked on had been published.
examples.translation: 他尝试搜索自己的名字，看看自己参与的作品是否已经发表。

meanings.text: 各种各样的；多种多样的

senses.gloss: 各种各样的；多种多样的

examples.text: They move between a variety of habitats, including forests, grasslands, woodlands, wetlands and agricultural land.
examples.translation: 它们会在多种栖息地之间迁移，包括森林、草原、林地、湿地和农田。

examples.text: Engaging in a variety of activities that stimulate the brain in different ways is helpful.
examples.translation: 参与各种以不同方式刺激大脑的活动是有益的。

examples.text: He attempted to show how all aspects of culture changed together in the evolution of societies.
examples.translation: 他试图说明，在社会演进过程中，文化的各个方面是如何共同变化的。

examples.text: Developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities to bypass taxes and regulations.
examples.translation: 开发商试图建设大规模短租设施，以规避税收和监管。

examples.text: This was an attempt to recover the valuable nails.
examples.translation: 这是一次回收这些贵重钉子的尝试。

meanings.grammar: turn out that ... / turn out to be ...
meanings.text: 结果是；原来是；后来证明

senses.gloss: 结果是；原来是；后来证明

examples.text: It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to different interpretations.
examples.translation: 结果发现，这种特殊的实验方式可能导致了不同的解释。

examples.text: It may turn out to be better for one to cultivate a few steady relationships.
examples.translation: 事实最终可能证明，培养少数几段稳定的关系反而更好。

meanings.grammar: appear to do / appear to be

examples.text: They may appear to be gliding across the surface but underneath their legs are paddling like crazy.
examples.translation: 它们表面上看似在水面滑行，但水下的腿其实在疯狂划动。

examples.text: More automation appears to be a certainty in industries eager to cut labor costs and raise profits.
examples.translation: 对于急于削减劳动力成本并提高利润的行业而言，进一步自动化似乎已成定局。

examples.text: People don't initiate actions even though they are able to do so if they are prompted.
examples.translation: 尽管在受到提示时他们能够行动，但他们不会主动发起行动。

examples.text: Even though humanity has always cherished beauty, our obsession with looks has reached an unprecedented peak.
examples.translation: 尽管人类一直珍视美，但我们对外表的痴迷已经达到前所未有的程度。

examples.text: He didn't mean sitting quietly in front of a laptop responding to emails.
examples.translation: 他指的并不是安静地坐在笔记本电脑前回复邮件。

examples.text: A machine can respond to the test as well as humans do.
examples.translation: 机器能够像人类一样对测试作出反应。

examples.text: Universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education.
examples.translation: 大学正在回应并适应消费者对高等教育的期待。

examples.text: How will the current urban generation respond to the inevitable social changes of mass urbanisation?
examples.translation: 当代城市一代将如何应对大规模城市化带来的必然社会变化？

examples.text: In order to achieve these objectives, we must concentrate more on coproductions.
examples.translation: 为了实现这些目标，我们必须更加重视联合制作。

examples.text: Patrons use the library to gain knowledge in order to create their own new and independent works.
examples.translation: 读者利用图书馆获取知识，以便创作属于自己的全新独立作品。

examples.text: Our conclusions are similar to those of Mr Mullany.
examples.translation: 我们的结论与穆拉尼先生的结论相似。

examples.text: This is similar to the way discomfort with uncertainty causes more anxiety than guaranteed bad news.
examples.translation: 这类似于这样一种情况：对不确定性的不适感，比确定会到来的坏消息更容易引发焦虑。

examples.text: [A] similar to [B] such as [C] along with [D] aside from
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: They tend to pay much closer attention to the value of goods and services than males.
examples.translation: 与雄性相比，它们往往会更加关注“商品和服务”的价值。

examples.text: Focus can blind us to what we're not actively paying attention to.
examples.translation: 专注也可能让我们忽视那些没有主动关注的事物。

examples.text: In other words, the choice to share news on social media may be the heart of the issue.
examples.translation: 换句话说，选择在社交媒体上分享新闻可能正是问题的核心。

examples.text: In other words, when we are sad about something, we may be more likely to fix it.
examples.translation: 也就是说，当我们因某件事而难过时，可能会更愿意设法解决它。

examples.text: When intolerance becomes a dominant part of how you interact with the world, it can lead to anxiety.
examples.translation: 当这种不耐受成为你与世界互动方式中的主导部分时，它可能引发焦虑。

examples.text: The mother relaxes her face and starts interacting with the infant again.
examples.translation: 母亲放松了面部表情，并重新开始与婴儿互动。

examples.text: In the brain, everything interacts with everything all the time.
examples.translation: 在大脑中，各个部分始终都在彼此相互作用。

examples.text: So far, more than 100,000 birds have been reported as colliding with a window.
examples.translation: 迄今已有超过 10 万只鸟被报告撞上窗户。

examples.text: But so far countries have donated only $6.6 billion to the fund.
examples.translation: 但到目前为止，各国仅向该基金捐赠了 66 亿美元。

examples.text: The data of an individual gains its value only when it is compared with the data of countless millions more.
examples.translation: 个人数据只有与数以百万计的其他人的数据相比较时，才会体现其价值。

examples.text: Britain has relatively few butterfly species compared with mainland Europe.
examples.translation: 与欧洲大陆相比，英国的蝴蝶种类相对较少。

examples.text: The combined consequences of suppression and climate change have eroded humanity's ability to suppress fires.
examples.translation: 长期压制火灾与气候变化共同造成的后果，削弱了人类控制火灾的能力。

examples.text: Another consequence of air that's too dry: the lungs' natural defenses to microbes weaken.
examples.translation: 空气过于干燥的另一个后果是：肺部抵御微生物的天然防御能力会减弱。

examples.text: The key to adjusting is figuring out how to redesign our economic systems.
examples.translation: 适应变化的关键在于弄清如何重新设计我们的经济体系。

examples.text: He came to believe that self-control was the key to success.
examples.translation: 他逐渐相信，自制力是成功的关键。

examples.text: AC is key to getting through summertime without a heat-related illness or worse.
examples.translation: 空调对于安全度过夏季、避免中暑等疾病甚至更严重后果至关重要。

examples.text: Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines.
examples.translation: 除新加坡外，其他政府和大型企业也开始制定自己的准则。

examples.text: The tool, along with other popular image-generation AI models, allows anyone to create impressive images.
examples.translation: 该工具连同其他流行的图像生成式人工智能模型，使任何人都能创作出令人印象深刻的图像。

examples.text: People raced to address increasing traffic problems along with the expansion of cities and traffic.
examples.translation: 随着城市扩张和交通增长，人们急于解决日益严重的交通问题。

meanings.grammar: refer to A as B / be referred to as
meanings.text: 把 A 称为 B；被称为

examples.text: Symmetry in dialogue refers to the balance of how much each partner talks.
examples.translation: 对话中的“对称”指的是双方说话量的平衡。

examples.text: It used to refer to people trying to protect wildlife and natural ecosystems.
examples.translation: 它过去指的是那些试图保护野生动物和自然生态系统的人。

examples.text: The student brings together the reasons Sammy quit his job by referring to his refusal to accept Lengel's store policies.
examples.translation: 这名学生通过提及萨米拒绝接受伦格尔商店政策这一点，归纳了他辞职的原因。

examples.text: This definition excludes many individuals usually referred to as intellectuals.
examples.translation: 这一定义排除了许多通常被称为知识分子的人。

examples.text: Other animals would not be capable of this finely developed sense of grievance.
examples.translation: 其他动物被认为不可能具备这种高度发达的不公平感。

examples.text: Introverts are equally capable of experiencing passion as extroverts.
examples.translation: 内向者和外向者同样能够感受到激情。

examples.text: Small sensors, capable of measuring all sorts of things, feed twins with real-time data.
examples.translation: 能够测量各种指标的小型传感器会为数字孪生提供实时数据。

meanings.text: 随着时间推移；逐渐；久而久之

examples.text: Spencer argued that all worldly phenomena, including human societies, changed over time.
examples.translation: 斯宾塞认为，包括人类社会在内的世间一切现象都会随着时间推移而变化。

examples.text: Over time, people can learn to tolerate uncertainty, and even accept it.
examples.translation: 随着时间推移，人们可以学会容忍不确定性，甚至接受它。

examples.text: As a result, the FAO's comparison of greenhouse gas emissions from livestock to those from transportation was greatly distorted.
examples.translation: 因此，联合国粮农组织对畜牧业与交通运输业温室气体排放的比较被严重扭曲了。

examples.text: As a result, many artists have been trying to ban AI art from art-sharing platforms.
examples.translation: 因此，许多艺术家一直试图禁止在艺术分享平台上发布人工智能生成的艺术作品。

examples.text: [A] by all means [B] at all costs [C] in a word [D] as a result
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Engaging in a variety of activities that stimulate the brain in different ways is helpful.
examples.translation: 参与各种以不同方式刺激大脑的活动是有益的。

examples.text: Much better to get the unhappy person to engage in an activity that you know she likes.
examples.translation: 更好的办法是让不开心的人参与一项你知道她喜欢的活动。

meanings.text: 对……必不可少；对……至关重要

examples.text: The independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
examples.translation: 对资本市场正常运行至关重要的准则制定机构独立性正在受到损害。

examples.text: Arts and aesthetic experiences are essential to the human condition.
examples.translation: 艺术和审美体验是人类生存状态不可或缺的一部分。

meanings.text: 处理……的方法；对……的方式；……的路径

examples.text: There are many different approaches to alternative grading.
examples.translation: 替代性评分有许多不同的方法。

examples.text: There is no one-size-fits-all approach to preventing decline as we age.
examples.translation: 对于预防随年龄增长而出现的衰退，并不存在一种适合所有人的统一方法。

meanings.grammar: a number of + 可数名词复数

examples.text: They also suffer from a number of nasty genetic diseases, such as breast cancer.
examples.translation: 他们还患有多种严重的遗传性疾病，例如乳腺癌。

examples.text: There are a number of consistent themes.
examples.translation: 其中存在若干一致的主题。

examples.text: At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
examples.translation: 与此同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国以及其他几个国家都曾认真考虑征收数字服务税。

examples.text: The dialogue will feel more productive, and at the same time, the relationship overall is likely to feel more positive.
examples.translation: 这样的对话会更富有成效，同时双方的整体关系也可能更加积极。

examples.text: Staff were concerned that they would not be able to get patients home in time for Christmas as the strikes took place the week beforehand.
examples.translation: 由于罢工发生在圣诞节前一周，工作人员担心无法及时让患者回家过节。

examples.text: Fruitful debates might actually take place in this area.
examples.translation: 这一领域实际上可能展开富有成效的辩论。

examples.text: No relationship has to be built before an exchange can take place.
examples.translation: 交流发生之前并不一定要先建立某种关系。

examples.text: Teams, even Stanley Cup winners, regularly go through 'ups' and 'downs' throughout the year.
examples.translation: 即使是斯坦利杯冠军球队，一年中也经常会经历起起伏伏。

examples.text: They find joy in going through simulated horrible experiences.
examples.translation: 他们会从经历模拟的可怕体验中获得乐趣。

examples.text: You should go through the paper many times, working to substantiate and clarify your ideas.
examples.translation: 你应该把论文反复审阅多遍，努力充实并阐明自己的观点。

examples.text: Police don't violate the Fourth Amendment when they go through the wallet or pocketbook of an arrestee without a warrant.
examples.translation: 警方在没有搜查令的情况下翻查被捕者的钱包，并不违反第四修正案。

examples.text: At first, we thought they were teasing, but as we retraced our steps, we were stunned.
examples.translation: 起初我们以为他们是在开玩笑，但当我们沿原路返回时，我们惊呆了。

examples.text: Trying it yourself is awkward and frustrating at first, but eventually it clicks.
examples.translation: 亲自尝试一开始会让人觉得笨拙又沮丧，但最终你会掌握诀窍。

meanings.text: 与……有关；与……相关；与……存在联系

examples.text: Some have linked the increase in depression and anxiety to smartphones and social media.
examples.translation: 一些人把抑郁和焦虑的增加与智能手机及社交媒体联系起来。

examples.text: Pet ownership alone was not linked to differences in loneliness, life satisfaction, psychological well-being or human social support.
examples.translation: 仅仅拥有宠物与孤独感、生活满意度、心理健康或人际支持方面的差异并无关联。

meanings.grammar: the rest of + 名词/代词

examples.text: For the rest of us, the brain has its ways of working through bad feelings.
examples.translation: 对于我们其余的人来说，大脑有自己的方式来消化负面情绪。

examples.text: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent.
examples.translation: 随后他们追踪了这些动物如何扩散到该大陆的其他地区。

examples.text: Indoor air pollution consistently adds to national mortality risk across income levels.
examples.translation: 无论收入水平如何，室内空气污染都会持续增加全国人口的死亡风险。

examples.text: This research adds to work suggesting that the brain isn't fully developed or stable until the late 20s or early 30s.
examples.translation: 这项研究进一步补充了已有证据：大脑要到二十多岁末甚至三十岁出头才会完全发育并趋于稳定。

examples.text: The report added to growing signs that inflation in the UK was proving more sticky than forecasters had hoped.
examples.translation: 这份报告进一步增加了证据，表明英国通胀比预测者原先希望的更为顽固。

examples.text: I realised what I had been doing was adding to a dataset for training the machine-learning software.
examples.translation: 我意识到自己一直在向一个用于训练机器学习软件的数据集添加数据。

meanings.text: 部分地；在某种程度上；部分原因是

examples.text: The value of knowledge depends, in part, upon wide distribution and ready access.
examples.translation: 知识的价值在一定程度上取决于广泛传播和便利获取。

examples.text: The positive effect might be explained in part by air pollution or the lack of it.
examples.translation: 这种积极效果在一定程度上可能可以由空气污染状况来解释。

examples.text: Gavin Newsom signed a slate of laws aimed at eliminating a deficit of 2.5 million housing units.
examples.translation: 加文·纽森签署了一系列旨在消除 250 万套住房缺口的法律。

examples.text: She tested out a number of games aimed at teaching children her age the value of money.
examples.translation: 她试用了多款旨在教同龄儿童理解金钱价值的游戏。

examples.text: Should you always practise serving from the exactly same location on the court, aiming at the same spot?
examples.translation: 你是否应该总是在球场同一位置练习发球，并瞄准同一个落点？

examples.text: Behind the scenes, they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters.
examples.translation: 在幕后，他们一直把矛头指向另一方：会计准则制定者。

examples.text: Different kinds of reading inform each other, and act as useful reference points and counterbalances to one another.
examples.translation: 不同类型的阅读彼此补充，并相互充当有用的参照和制衡。

examples.text: Muscle also acts as a reserve of amino acids that the body can draw upon during periods of illness.
examples.translation: 肌肉还充当氨基酸储备，人体在患病时可以从中调用。

examples.text: [A] call for [B] yield to [C] insist on [D] act as
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Personnel accounts for 80 percent of the agency's costs.
examples.translation: 人员成本占该机构总成本的 80%。

examples.text: US capital spending on AI currently accounts for 1.5% of the US economy.
examples.translation: 美国在人工智能方面的资本支出目前占美国经济总量的 1.5%。

examples.text: The railroad companies accounted for about 60% of the US stock market in the 1880s.
examples.translation: 19 世纪 80 年代，铁路公司约占美国股票市场的 60%。

examples.text: They then compared those factors with measures of physical health, psychological well-being, loneliness, life satisfaction and social support.
examples.translation: 随后，他们把这些因素与身体健康、心理健康、孤独感、生活满意度和社会支持等衡量指标进行比较。

examples.text: Being known by your spouse improved all three measures of marital happiness.
examples.translation: 被配偶真正了解，会改善婚姻幸福感的三项衡量指标。

examples.text: Even a happy life cannot be without a measure of darkness.
examples.translation: 即使幸福的生活也不可能完全没有一丝阴暗。

examples.text: Some measure of discomfort is just as crucial to our survival as rest and relaxation.
examples.translation: 一定程度的不适与休息和放松一样，对我们的生存至关重要。

examples.text: They cannot be compared to works of art produced for sale.
examples.translation: 它们不能与为出售而创作的艺术品相提并论。

examples.text: People who almost never remember their dreams do not seem to have obvious cognitive deficits compared to those who dream a lot.
examples.translation: 与经常做梦的人相比，几乎从不记得梦境的人似乎并没有明显的认知缺陷。

examples.text: The rise of citizen science has grown alongside the rise of do-it-yourself biology laboratories around the world.
examples.translation: 公民科学的兴起伴随着世界各地自助式生物实验室的发展。

examples.text: Researchers found that around the world people's desired amount of personal space varied.
examples.translation: 研究人员发现，世界各地的人们对个人空间的需求各不相同。

examples.text: At the end of the semester, the student and teacher collaboratively determine a final grade.
examples.translation: 在学期结束时，学生和教师共同确定最终成绩。

examples.text: At the end of the six-week period, you will most likely have created the habit.
examples.translation: 六周结束时，你很可能已经养成了这个习惯。

examples.text: There is a coalition growing within artist industries to figure out how to tackle or mitigate this.
examples.translation: 艺术行业内部正在形成一个联盟，以弄清如何应对或缓解这一问题。

examples.text: The key to adjusting is figuring out how to redesign our economic systems.
examples.translation: 适应变化的关键在于弄清如何重新设计我们的经济体系。

examples.text: Figure out the best time of day for your timetable.
examples.translation: 找出一天中最适合安排这件事的时间。

examples.text: Scientists are increasingly seeking out visual artists to help them communicate their work to new audiences.
examples.translation: 科学家正越来越主动寻找视觉艺术家，帮助他们向新的受众传播研究成果。

examples.text: Many individuals seek out challenging activities such as puzzles or crosswords because the effort itself is enjoyable.
examples.translation: 许多人会主动寻找拼图或填字游戏等有挑战性的活动，因为付出努力本身就令人愉快。

examples.text: The board is responsible for market value on behalf of shareholders.
examples.translation: 董事会代表股东对公司的市场价值负责。

examples.text: Teachers are responsible for teaching kids how to learn.
examples.translation: 教师负责教孩子如何学习。

examples.text: Cones are responsible for vision in bright light.
examples.translation: 视锥细胞负责明亮环境下的视觉。

examples.text: The food sector is already responsible for nearly a third of global greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.translation: 食品行业已经造成了全球近三分之一的温室气体排放。

examples.text: The allegation that farm animals produce the world's largest portion of greenhouse gases is responsible for meat's bad reputation.
examples.translation: “畜牧业产生全球最大份额温室气体”的说法，是肉类声誉不佳的原因之一。

examples.text: To serve as responsible stewards of the planet, we must press forward on deeper atmospheric and oceanic research.
examples.translation: 为了成为负责任的地球守护者，我们必须推进更深入的大气和海洋研究。

examples.text: The sharks also serve as a cautionary tale against hubris.
examples.translation: 这些鲨鱼的遭遇也成为警示人们不要自负的前车之鉴。

examples.text: The signal system on the railroad served as the basis for the first traffic light.
examples.translation: 铁路信号系统成为第一盏交通信号灯的基础。

examples.text: The more times someone is exposed to a statement, the more likely they are to say it is true.
examples.translation: 一个人接触某种说法的次数越多，就越可能认为它是真的。

examples.text: The primary way plants are exposed to microplastics is through the air.
examples.translation: 植物接触微塑料的主要途径是空气。

examples.text: About half of parents of teens are worried about their teens being exposed to explicit content online.
examples.translation: 大约一半的青少年家长担心孩子在网上接触到露骨内容。

meanings.text: 成功；奏效；得到理想结果

senses.gloss: 成功；奏效；得到理想结果

examples.text: The new system has not worked out any cheaper for the universities.
examples.translation: 事实证明，新制度并没有让大学节省多少成本。

examples.text: Projects, relationships, and jobs don't always work out as planned.
examples.translation: 项目、人际关系和工作并不总能按计划顺利发展。

examples.text: Work out for 30 minutes each time.
examples.translation: 每次锻炼 30 分钟。

examples.text: Many ancient civilisations built architectural models to work out how to build things.
examples.translation: 许多古代文明会制作建筑模型，以弄清东西该如何建造。

examples.text: Roman lamps and Roman chariots are very different from LED strips and sports cars.
examples.translation: 罗马油灯和罗马战车与 LED 灯带和跑车截然不同。

examples.text: Secondary forests in the Amazon are different from Texas pines recovering after wildfires.
examples.translation: 亚马孙的次生林不同于得克萨斯州野火后恢复的松林。

examples.text: Many managers see it as disruptive to team cohesion and a threat to their ability to lead.
examples.translation: 许多管理者认为这会破坏团队凝聚力，并威胁他们的领导能力。

examples.text: Withdrawing from one commitment can feel like a threat to our identity or status.
examples.translation: 退出某项承诺可能让人感觉自己的身份或地位受到了威胁。

examples.text: As the world continues to urbanise, the voices calling for rural preservation may well grow louder.
examples.translation: 随着世界继续城市化，呼吁保护乡村的声音很可能会越来越响亮。

examples.text: Some activists have even called for taxing meat to reduce consumption of it.
examples.translation: 一些活动人士甚至呼吁对肉类征税，以减少肉类消费。

examples.text: Meeting this demand without contributing to climate change calls for urgent solutions.
examples.translation: 在不加剧气候变化的前提下满足这种需求，需要迫切的解决方案。

examples.text: [A] call for [B] yield to [C] insist on [D] act as
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: The trend of women returning to work after childbirth started.
examples.translation: 女性生育后重返工作的趋势开始出现。

examples.text: Wild animals that cannot be returned to their natural habitats...
examples.translation: 无法被送回自然栖息地的野生动物……

examples.text: Ancient art displayed in foreign countries should be returned to the original country.
examples.translation: 陈列在外国的古代艺术品应被归还给原属国。

examples.text: With time, nature may return to its original state without human intervention.
examples.translation: 随着时间推移，在条件合适的情况下，自然可能无需人为干预便恢复到原始状态。

meanings.grammar: see A as B / be seen as

examples.text: That would make rulings more likely to be seen as separate from politics.
examples.translation: 这样会使裁决更容易被视为独立于政治。

examples.text: Many managers see it as disruptive to team cohesion.
examples.translation: 许多管理者把它视为会破坏团队凝聚力的因素。

examples.text: Personalisation is seen as key to the appeal of this technology.
examples.translation: 个性化被视为这项技术具有吸引力的关键。

examples.text: It's just that they have so much more to cope with.
examples.translation: 只不过她们需要应对的事情多得多。

examples.text: Most women today are coping with a lot of obligations, with few breaks.
examples.translation: 如今大多数女性都在应付许多责任，却很少有休息的机会。

examples.text: These leaders cope with disagreements either by shutting them down or ignoring them.
examples.translation: 这些领导者要么压制分歧，要么忽视分歧，以此来应对意见不合。

examples.text: [A] coped with [B] consisted of [C] hinted at [D] extended to
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Leaving without a position lined up gave him time to reflect on what kind of company he wanted to run.
examples.translation: 在没有下一份工作的情况下离职，让他有时间认真思考自己想经营什么样的公司。

examples.text: Pause for five minutes during any task to reflect on what you might be overlooking.
examples.translation: 在做任何任务时停下来五分钟，思考自己可能忽略了什么。

examples.text: People who reflected on experiences they had acquired reported a broader sense of connection to humanity.
examples.translation: 回想自己获得过的经历的人，会感受到与整个人类更广泛的联系。

examples.text: Scientists are finding out that certain changes in brain function may not be inevitable.
examples.translation: 科学家正在发现，大脑功能的某些变化可能并非不可避免。

examples.text: We spoke to several experts to find out why they don't recommend we wear this style of boot.
examples.translation: 我们采访了几位专家，以弄清他们为什么不建议穿这种靴子。

examples.text: I was stunned by what I found out about this principle.
examples.translation: 我对自己查明的有关这一原理的事实感到震惊。

examples.text: The great question is who should benefit from the analysis of all the data that our lives now generate.
examples.translation: 关键问题是，谁应该从分析我们生活产生的全部数据中受益。

examples.text: Children benefit from playing with their parents.
examples.translation: 孩子会从与父母一起玩耍中受益。

examples.text: It's worth pointing out that we don't need to be particularly talented in a given artistic field to benefit from it.
examples.translation: 值得指出的是，我们不需要在某个艺术领域特别有天赋，也能从中受益。

meanings.text: 就……而言；从……方面来看；在……方面

examples.text: Television companies will have to cooperate more closely in terms of both production and distribution.
examples.translation: 电视公司在制作和发行两方面都必须进行更密切的合作。

examples.text: Toddlers are light-years ahead in terms of development and already talking.
examples.translation: 幼儿在发育程度上已经领先许多，而且已经会说话了。

examples.text: We go where there are rougher conditions in terms of weather.
examples.translation: 我们会前往天气条件更恶劣的地方。

examples.text: [A] As well as [B] In terms of [C] Thanks to [D] Rather than
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Their increase in height appears to result from the increasingly common practice of recruiting players from all over the world.
examples.translation: 他们身高的增加似乎源于越来越普遍的全球招募球员做法。

examples.text: Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social values.
examples.translation: 宪法具有政治性，因为它源自在基本社会价值观基础上作出的选择。

examples.text: They often result from simulation learning experiences.
examples.translation: 它们往往源于模拟学习经历。

examples.text: This is not yet another criticism against the decline in education.
examples.translation: 这并不是又一次对教育衰退的批评。

examples.text: Muscle loss is associated with a decline in fluid intelligence.
examples.translation: 肌肉流失与流体智力下降有关。

examples.text: This was a step up from the 0.6% decline in prices in December.
examples.translation: 这比 12 月价格下降 0.6% 的情况有所改善。

examples.text: Only in recent years has it become a feature of undergraduate programs in Canadian universities.
examples.translation: 直到近年来，它才成为加拿大大学本科课程的一个特点。

examples.text: Many of the most interesting books in recent years have come from small publishers.
examples.translation: 近年来许多最有趣的书都出自小型出版社。

examples.text: In recent years, social media has helped spread alternative grading ideas.
examples.translation: 近年来，社交媒体帮助传播了替代性评分理念。

examples.text: The company is currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones.
examples.translation: 这家公司目前卷入了与 Waterstones 的对峙。

examples.text: When people get involved in making artifacts in architecture or art, they apply these general concepts in unique ways.
examples.translation: 当人们参与建筑或艺术制品的创作时，会以独特方式运用这些普遍概念。

examples.text: The number of women involved in legislative decisions has significant implications.
examples.translation: 参与立法决策的女性人数具有重要影响。

examples.text: AI tools can bypass the considerable labor involved in creating art works.
examples.translation: 人工智能工具可以绕过艺术创作过程中所需的大量劳动。

examples.text: Parenting tips obtained from hunter-gatherers in Africa may be the key to bringing up more contented children.
examples.translation: 从非洲狩猎采集者那里获得的育儿经验，可能是培养更快乐孩子的关键。

examples.text: The key to adjusting is figuring out how to redesign our economic systems.
examples.translation: 适应变化的关键在于弄清如何重新设计我们的经济体系。

examples.text: Self-control was the key to success.
examples.translation: 自制力是成功的关键。

examples.text: She has been exploring the impact of green space on children since 2012.
examples.translation: 自 2012 年以来，她一直在研究绿色空间对儿童的影响。

examples.text: The impact of variability depends on whether it is relevant to the task or not.
examples.translation: 变异性的影响取决于它是否与任务相关。

examples.text: Understanding the impact of variability is important for literally every aspect of our daily life.
examples.translation: 理解变异性的影响实际上对日常生活的方方面面都很重要。

examples.text: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
examples.translation: 我们如何确保智能机器的思维反映人类最高层次的价值观？

examples.text: Drink a decent amount of water alongside your morning brew to make sure you're adequately hydrated.
examples.translation: 早晨喝咖啡时也要喝足量的水，以确保身体水分充足。

examples.text: Make sure you keep careful track of the common ground between you.
examples.translation: 务必仔细留意你们之间的共同点。

examples.text: Ginger can help with ailments ranging from nausea to inflammation.
examples.translation: 生姜可能有助于缓解从恶心到炎症等多种不适。

examples.text: Its clues ranged from simple to niche.
examples.translation: 它的线索从简单常见到冷门专业不等。

examples.text: The market for AI companions, ranging from friends to romantic partners, is already crowded.
examples.translation: 人工智能陪伴产品市场已经十分拥挤，其类型从朋友式陪伴到恋爱伴侣不等。

examples.text: The Nobels were themselves set up by a very rich individual.
examples.translation: 诺贝尔奖本身就是由一位非常富有的人设立的。

examples.text: No account or record indicates any trust or the like was set up to facilitate this.
examples.translation: 没有任何账目或记录表明曾设立信托或类似安排来促成此事。

examples.text: They then set up a 'food station' experiment.
examples.translation: 随后他们搭建了一个“食物站”实验。

examples.text: Millennials were told that if they did well in school and got a decent degree, they would be set up for life.
examples.translation: 千禧一代曾被告知，只要在学校表现好并取得不错的学位，一生就会有保障。

examples.text: A poem draws a picture of reality that sets up a contradiction with your own.
examples.translation: 诗歌描绘一种现实图景，并由此与你自己的现实形成矛盾。

examples.text: Different kinds of reading inform each other, and act as useful reference points and counterbalances to one another.
examples.translation: 不同类型的阅读彼此补充，并互相充当有用的参照和制衡。

examples.text: Reports of increased polarization shouldn't persuade us to look away from one another.
examples.translation: 有关两极分化加剧的报道不应让我们彼此疏远。

examples.text: We must get honest about how these social diseases impact the ways we treat one another.
examples.translation: 我们必须坦诚面对这些社会弊病如何影响我们彼此相待的方式。

examples.text: Are humans actually aware of the world they live in?
examples.translation: 人类真的意识到自己所生活的世界吗？

examples.text: The majority of people who use networked computers to upload are not even aware of the significance of what they are doing.
examples.translation: 大多数使用联网电脑上传内容的人甚至没有意识到自己所做事情的重要性。

examples.text: They were also aware of how rare the animals were becoming.
examples.translation: 他们也意识到这些动物正变得越来越稀少。

examples.text: Demand for the animals seemed to be increasing.
examples.translation: 对这些动物的需求似乎正在增加。

examples.text: Self-order screens mean more demand for people front-of-house.
examples.translation: 自助点餐屏意味着前台岗位对人员的需求会增加。

examples.text: Demand for meat is rising in developing and emerging economies.
examples.translation: 发展中和新兴经济体对肉类的需求正在上升。

examples.text: In addition to identifying a memory source from the past, Wamsley asked participants to provide information about anticipated future events.
examples.translation: 除了识别过去的记忆来源外，沃姆斯利还要求参与者提供有关预期未来事件的信息。

examples.text: In addition to being a major tourism draw, lemurs are essential seed dispersers and pollinators.
examples.translation: 狐猴除了是重要的旅游吸引物之外，还是不可或缺的种子传播者和传粉者。

examples.text: [A] On the basis of [B] At the cost of [C] In addition to [D] In contrast to
examples.translation: 完形填空

meanings.text: 一般来说；总体上；整体而言

senses.gloss: 一般来说；总体上；整体而言

examples.text: In general, doing more exercise is better, though adding more eventually becomes too much.
examples.translation: 一般来说，多锻炼更好，不过增加到一定程度后也会过量。

examples.text: More research will be needed before drawing conclusions for agriculture in general.
examples.translation: 在对整个农业领域作出结论之前，还需要更多研究。

examples.text: The public in general, particularly future generations, was another great beneficiary of the railway boom.
examples.translation: 广大公众，尤其是后代，也是铁路繁荣的另一大受益者。

examples.text: [A] To be fair [B] For instance [C] To be brief [D] In general
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: We aim to be objective, but we cannot escape the context of our unique life experiences.
examples.translation: 我们力求保持客观，但无法摆脱自身独特生活经历的影响。

examples.text: Alternative grading models aim to give students a better chance to demonstrate their potential.
examples.translation: 替代性评分模式旨在给学生更好的机会展示自身潜力。

examples.text: The government has stated aims to make the new curriculum more accessible and relevant for pupils.
examples.translation: 政府提出的目标是让新课程对学生而言更容易理解，也更具相关性。

examples.text: They had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
examples.translation: 他们还成功把它嵌入了一个每天有数十亿人使用的全球系统。

examples.text: We finally managed to get there.
examples.translation: 我们最终成功做到了。

examples.text: Big food has so far managed to thrive even as concerns around consumers' health have swirled.
examples.translation: 即使消费者健康问题引发诸多担忧，大型食品企业迄今仍设法保持了繁荣。

meanings.grammar: as long as + 条件从句

examples.text: You can win by cheating as long as you don't get caught.
examples.translation: 只要不被抓到，你就可能靠作弊获胜。

examples.text: As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity.
examples.translation: 只要经济仍是政府的首要任务，它们只需确保公民持续保持生产力。

examples.text: With MRS, it may take as long as 45 minutes on average.
examples.translation: 使用 MRS 时，平均可能需要长达 45 分钟。

examples.text: To keep the food cold as long as possible.
examples.translation: 为了让食物尽可能长时间保持低温。

examples.text: Legal penalty is a major solution to data leakage.
examples.translation: 法律处罚是解决数据泄露问题的一项重要手段。

examples.text: Some believe the exclusive solution to the climate crisis is renewable energy.
examples.translation: 一些人认为，应对气候危机唯一的解决方案是可再生能源。

examples.text: They have found a solution to the global problem of air pollution.
examples.translation: 他们已经找到了全球空气污染问题的一种解决方案。

examples.text: Creators, as many prefer to be called, have become integral to how consumers shop.
examples.translation: “创作者”——许多人更喜欢这样称呼自己——已经成为消费者购物方式中不可或缺的一部分。

examples.text: Do you prefer to be told where to go or to have a map sketched for you?
examples.translation: 你更喜欢别人直接告诉你怎么走，还是给你画一张路线图？

examples.text: Some teachers have said they prefer to work alone.
examples.translation: 一些教师表示，他们更喜欢独自工作。

examples.text: Most leaders sought to maintain Catholicism as the official religion, while some sought to end the persecution of other faiths.
examples.translation: 多数领导人试图维持天主教作为官方宗教的地位，而另一些人则试图结束对其他信仰的迫害。

examples.text: Its founders sought to raise the status of artists.
examples.translation: 它的创办者试图提高艺术家的地位。

examples.text: Researchers sought to determine how our personality may be linked to our preferred amount of personal space.
examples.translation: 研究人员试图弄清我们的性格可能如何与偏好的个人空间大小相关。

examples.text: As the economy picks up, opportunities will abound for aspiring leaders.
examples.translation: 随着经济复苏，有抱负的领导者将迎来大量机会。

examples.text: We're giving our customers better channels versus picking up the phone.
examples.translation: 与拿起电话相比，我们正为客户提供更好的沟通渠道。

examples.text: On a busy day Miki picks up 20 or 30 birds, a few of which are still alive.
examples.translation: 忙的时候，米基一天会捡到二三十只鸟，其中有几只还活着。

examples.text: Some of the birds that I pick up I would be over the moon to see in the wild setting.
examples.translation: 我捡到的一些鸟，如果能在野外看到它们，我会欣喜若狂。

examples.text: [A] follow up [B] pick up [C] open up [D] end up
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education.
examples.translation: 大学正在回应消费者对高等教育的期待。

examples.text: World War II was the watershed event for higher education in modern Western societies.
examples.translation: 第二次世界大战是现代西方社会高等教育发展的分水岭事件。

examples.text: Most institutions of higher education rely on synthetic pesticides and fertilizers.
examples.translation: 大多数高等教育机构依赖合成农药和化肥。

examples.text: Marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
examples.translation: 营销的影响源于传统付费媒体之外的一系列广泛因素。

examples.text: Nigeria's failure to control the flow of dangerous pesticides stems from weak governance and outdated laws.
examples.translation: 尼日利亚未能控制危险农药的流通，源于治理薄弱和法律过时。

examples.text: This anxiety likely stems from a fear of the unknown.
examples.translation: 这种焦虑很可能源于对未知事物的恐惧。

meanings.text: 最重要的是；尤其是；首要的是

examples.text: Above all, they tend to pay much closer attention to the value of 'goods and services' than males.
examples.translation: 最重要的是，与雄性相比，它们往往更关注“商品和服务”的价值。

examples.text: A high growth rate placed great strains on governance, administration, and above all socialization.
examples.translation: 高增长率给治理、行政管理，尤其是社会化机制带来了巨大压力。

examples.text: [A] Above all [B] On average [C] In principle [D] For example
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: People give up all kinds of opportunities that involve the possibility of failure.
examples.translation: 人们会放弃各种存在失败可能性的机会。

examples.text: Half of new-year resolvers give up by the end of March.
examples.translation: 大约一半制定新年计划的人到三月底就放弃了。

examples.text: The wisest leaders learn to distinguish between giving up too soon and sticking with something irrationally.
examples.translation: 最明智的领导者会学会区分过早放弃与不理性地坚持。

examples.text: Giving up bad habits can require repeated attempts.
examples.translation: 戒掉坏习惯可能需要反复尝试。

examples.text: You should not give up on giving up bad habits.
examples.translation: 你不应该放弃戒掉坏习惯这件事。

meanings.text: 就……达成一致；对……意见一致

examples.text: Analysts do agree on another matter.
examples.translation: 分析人士在另一个问题上确实达成了一致。

examples.text: Most find it difficult to agree on what a 'general education' should look like.
examples.translation: 大多数人都发现，很难就“通识教育”应当是什么样子达成一致。

examples.text: Experts have a hard time agreeing on what is the real object and what is a forgery.
examples.translation: 专家们很难就哪些是真品、哪些是赝品达成一致。

meanings.text: 很可能；完全可能；大概会

examples.text: Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits.
examples.translation: 掌握欧洲批发业务复杂门道的零售商，很可能会获得可观利润。

examples.text: Its report may well set back reform by obscuring the depth and breadth of the challenge.
examples.translation: 这份报告很可能会因为掩盖问题的深度和广度而阻碍改革。

examples.text: Smell may well play a part in African elephants' long-distance navigation.
examples.translation: 嗅觉很可能在非洲象的长距离导航中发挥作用。

meanings.text: 试验；尝试使用；尝试不同做法
对……进行实验；以……为实验对象

senses.gloss: 试验；尝试使用；尝试不同做法

examples.text: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and their preferences.
examples.translation: 如今个人可以尝试不同的外观，并探索自己的偏好。

examples.text: Many college faculty and some K-12 teachers are experimenting with different grading models.
examples.translation: 许多大学教师以及部分中小学教师正在尝试不同的评分模式。

examples.text: Companies such as Domino and Just Eat have both experimented with robot and drone delivery.
examples.translation: Domino 和 Just Eat 等公司都曾试验机器人和无人机配送。

senses.gloss: 对……进行实验；以……为实验对象

examples.text: Experiments with toddlers already talking quelled any doubts.
examples.translation: 以已经会说话的幼儿为对象的实验消除了任何疑虑。

examples.text: Public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers.
examples.translation: 公共卫生倡导者应该借鉴广告商的做法。

examples.text: Global challenges and social innovations ought to receive much more attention from scientists.
examples.translation: 全球性挑战和社会创新应当得到科学家更多的关注。

examples.text: Researchers admit that their study does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR.
examples.translation: 研究人员承认，他们的研究并未回答企业应当在企业社会责任上投入多少的问题。

examples.text: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
examples.translation: 最成功的君主制国家会努力摒弃或隐藏旧有的贵族作风。

examples.text: You will identify and can then strive to be the best version of yourself.
examples.translation: 你会认清自己，并进而努力成为最好的自己。

examples.text: They strive to prevent their kids from spending excessive screen time.
examples.translation: 他们努力防止孩子在屏幕前花费过多时间。

examples.text: You can start even if others refuse to.
examples.translation: 即使别人拒绝行动，你也可以先开始。

examples.text: Peters refuses to tamper with wild butterflies.
examples.translation: 彼得斯拒绝人为摆弄野生蝴蝶。

examples.text: Benevolent leaders end up micromanaging their people when they refuse to delegate completely.
examples.translation: 一些善意的领导者因为不肯充分授权，最终会陷入事无巨细的管理。

examples.text: In contrast, suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty.
examples.translation: 相比之下，假设你提出一个合理的论点：全职工作者不应生活在贫困之中。

examples.text: In contrast, high-dependence relationships can be imbued with values and relational dynamics that are not simply calculated.
examples.translation: 相比之下，高依赖关系可能包含无法简单计算的价值观和关系动力。

examples.text: Productive debates might be possible, in contrast to the familiar mutual condemnation in discussing other issues.
examples.translation: 与讨论其他问题时常见的相互谴责不同，这一议题上或许能够展开富有成效的辩论。

examples.text: [A] In contrast [B] As a result [C] On the whole [D] For instance
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Thanks to his invention, we have a real chance to decrease the world's carbon emissions.
examples.translation: 多亏了他的发明，我们真正有机会降低全球碳排放。

examples.text: Consumers may at last be able to alter their diets thanks to new blockbuster weight-loss drugs.
examples.translation: 由于新型重磅减肥药的出现，消费者或许终于能够改变自己的饮食。

examples.text: Countries that manage to run off renewables typically do so thanks to extraordinary hydroelectric capabilities.
examples.translation: 能够主要依靠可再生能源运行的国家，通常得益于出色的水力发电能力。

examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Mozart is used to help newborn babies adapt to life outside of the mother's belly.
examples.translation: 人们会用莫扎特的音乐帮助新生儿适应母体之外的生活。

examples.text: My ability to adapt to and develop my career identity has been crucial to my wellbeing.
examples.translation: 我适应并发展自身职业身份的能力，对我的幸福感至关重要。

examples.text: We have to adapt to the ever-changing goal.
examples.translation: 我们必须适应不断变化的目标。

examples.text: [A] adapt to [B] provide for [C] compete with [D] decide on
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Personality can affect how a person reacts to eye contact.
examples.translation: 性格会影响一个人对眼神接触的反应。

examples.text: People with a higher intolerance can react to events more impulsively.
examples.translation: 对不确定性容忍度较低的人，对事件的反应也可能更加冲动。

examples.text: Mindfulness can help us learn not to react to experience with likes and dislikes or judgments of good and bad.
examples.translation: 正念可以帮助我们学会不再以好恶或善恶判断来回应经历。

examples.text: Either Entergy never really intended to live by those commitments, or it simply didn't foresee what would happen next.
examples.translation: 要么 Entergy 从未真正打算履行这些承诺，要么它只是没有预见接下来会发生什么。

examples.text: You may intend to get away from your desk, but it holds you there nonetheless.
examples.translation: 你可能本来打算离开办公桌，但它还是把你困在那里。

examples.text: The authorities intended to investigate the practice.
examples.translation: 有关部门打算调查这种做法。

examples.text: It can be intended to hurt and is often bitter and biting.
examples.translation: 它可能是有意伤人的，而且常常尖刻刺耳。

examples.text: Lower-income jobs like gardening or day care don't appeal to robots.
examples.translation: 园艺或日托等低收入工作对机器人并没有吸引力。

examples.text: It is seductive because it appeals to our instincts.
examples.translation: 它之所以诱人，是因为它迎合了我们的本能。

examples.text: Tan's job is to create recipes that will appeal to both local and international tastes.
examples.translation: Tan 的工作是设计既符合本地口味又能吸引国际食客的菜谱。

examples.text: Something appealed to my soul.
examples.translation: 某种东西触动了我的心灵。

examples.text: Data needs to be guarded as much as any other asset.
examples.translation: 数据需要像其他任何资产一样受到严密保护。

examples.text: The print edition costs more than twice as much as a digital-only subscription.
examples.translation: 纸质版的费用是纯数字订阅的两倍多。

examples.text: Livestock does not necessarily represent as much as or more than transportation.
examples.translation: 畜牧业的排放并不一定与交通运输业一样多，或比它更多。

examples.text: As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards, two things seem clear.
examples.translation: 尽管一些科学家可能会抱怨这些新奖项，但有两点似乎很明确。

examples.text: They're showing up in cities as much as 120 miles from their home forests.
examples.translation: 它们甚至出现在距离原生森林多达 120 英里的城市里。

meanings.text: 某种程度的；一定程度的

examples.text: The task requires immediate feedback and a high degree of concentration.
examples.translation: 这项任务需要即时反馈和高度集中注意力。

examples.text: Monteiro sorted food into four buckets based on the degree of processing undertaken.
examples.translation: Monteiro 根据加工程度把食品分为四类。

examples.text: These people may display a problematic degree of emotional vulnerability.
examples.translation: 这些人可能表现出令人担忧的情绪脆弱程度。

examples.text: It is important to understand why convenience is so seductive in the first place.
examples.translation: 首先要理解的是，便利为什么会如此诱人。

examples.text: Why people learn bad habits in the first place remains mysterious.
examples.translation: 人们一开始为什么会养成坏习惯，仍然是个谜。

examples.text: Students cannot understand today's conflicts without understanding what caused them in the first place.
examples.translation: 学生如果不了解这些冲突最初是如何产生的，就无法理解今天的冲突。

examples.text: They could in turn afford more education.
examples.translation: 这样一来，他们又能够负担更多教育。

examples.text: Investment enables a huge build-out of infrastructure, in turn pushing the technology towards mainstream adoption.
examples.translation: 投资推动了基础设施的大规模建设，进而促使这项技术走向主流应用。

examples.text: These memories, in turn, can encourage engagement in even more sociality.
examples.translation: 这些记忆反过来又会促使人们参与更多社交活动。

examples.text: Birdsong begins across each continent and island in turn.
examples.translation: 鸟鸣依次在各个大陆和岛屿上响起。

meanings.text: 自从……以来；从那以后一直

senses.gloss: 自从……以来；从那以后一直

examples.text: Business-method patents have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
examples.translation: 商业方法专利自十年前首次获准以来一直备受争议。

examples.text: Consumer confidence has been dire ever since the recent inflation surge.
examples.translation: 自最近一轮通胀飙升以来，消费者信心一直十分低迷。

examples.text: Ever since the green revolution of the 1960s, high-yielding crops have dominated modern agriculture.
examples.translation: 自 20 世纪 60 年代的绿色革命以来，高产作物一直主导着现代农业。

examples.text: Those suffering from persistent nightmares should seek help from a therapist.
examples.translation: 长期受噩梦困扰的人应该寻求治疗师的帮助。

examples.text: It may be a safe intervention for children suffering from attention disorders.
examples.translation: 对于患有注意力障碍的儿童来说，这或许是一种安全的干预方式。

examples.translation: 正念有助于慢性疾病患者的康复。

examples.translation: 30 名儿童中只有 5 人参加了后续活动。

examples.translation: 他们两者实际上都没有参与任何动物研究或保护方面的贡献。

examples.translation: 研究人员招募了 27 只猎犬参加一项为期三年的实验。

examples.text: Enhanced security measures, combined with a rise in airline travel, have resulted in long waits at major airports.
examples.translation: 加强的安保措施加上航空出行增加，导致一些大型机场出现长时间等待。

examples.text: The body is better able to absorb curcumin when it is combined with piperine.
examples.translation: 姜黄素与胡椒碱结合时，人体更容易吸收它。

examples.text: These, combined with a rapidly rising world population, give us compelling reasons to work for greater efficiencies in animal agriculture.
examples.translation: 这些因素再加上世界人口快速增长，使我们有充分理由提高畜牧业效率。

meanings.text: 不能；无力；缺乏做……的能力

examples.text: An inability to consider the big picture was leading decision-makers to be biased.
examples.translation: 无法考虑全局，正使决策者产生偏见。

examples.text: Another challenge was Simon's inability to keep firm lines between his work and home life.
examples.translation: 另一个挑战是 Simon 无法明确划分工作与家庭生活。

examples.translation: 人类的许多问题源于人无法独自安静地待在房间里。

meanings.text: 不愿；勉强；不情愿做某事

examples.text: The second monkey was reluctant to hand hers over for a mere piece of cucumber.
examples.translation: 第二只猴子不愿只为了得到一块黄瓜就交出自己的代币。

examples.translation: 许多社会科学家似乎不愿处理此类问题。

examples.translation: 游客可以把一切看个遍，并在夜幕降临前离开城镇。

examples.translation: 不用手臂支撑就从椅子上站起来会变得更加困难。

examples.translation: 我怎样才能摆脱这个恶性循环？

examples.translation: 有个人你怎么也无法从脑海中挥去。

examples.text: The benefits include a concern for nature in adult life.
examples.translation: 这些益处包括成年后对自然的关爱。

examples.text: It is a bond strengthened by the concern for the well-being of others or the common good.
examples.translation: 这种纽带因对他人福祉或公共利益的关切而得到加强。

examples.text: The impact of its products on health has long been a concern for shoppers and policymakers alike.
examples.translation: 其产品对健康的影响长期以来一直令消费者和政策制定者担忧。

examples.translation: 它绝不是同类中唯一的一个。

examples.translation: 特罗姆瑟的极夜远非一段完全黑暗的时期。

examples.translation: 它们为什么会影响学习，远未得到充分理解。

examples.text: Economic realities and human experience strayed further and further from each other.
examples.translation: 经济现实与人们对现实的体验彼此越来越疏远。

examples.translation: 政府改善了与工会人士的关系。

examples.translation: 你投入经营了与某人的关系，因此受到邀请一起吃饭。

examples.text: If dreams have a relationship with memory, it is not quite as simple as dreaming of something that must be remembered.
examples.translation: 如果梦与记忆存在联系，那么这种关系并不是简单地梦到需要记住的东西。

examples.text: You should be looking to stick to your normal bedtime.
examples.translation: 你应该尽量坚持平时的就寝时间。

examples.translation: 大多数人开始锻炼计划时遇到的问题，是难以坚持下去。

examples.translation: 坚持自己向陌生人表达礼貌的方式。

examples.translation: 大多数气味会附着在物体表面。

examples.translation: 想出一个具体的“如果……那么……”陈述，帮助自己实现目标。

examples.translation: 帮助他们想出提前学习和准备的方法。

examples.text: Garrett Morgan came up with an affordable, patented traffic signal.
examples.translation: Garrett Morgan 发明了一种价格可负担且获得专利的交通信号装置。

examples.text: Good writing most often occurs when you are in hot pursuit of an idea.
examples.translation: 优秀写作往往出现在你全力追寻某个想法的时候。

examples.text: One study linked self-control to the pursuit of goals that you value and enjoy.
examples.translation: 一项研究把自制力与追求自己重视且喜欢的目标联系起来。

examples.text: The chaos of everyday life is an obstacle in the pursuit of stable friendships.
examples.translation: 日常生活的混乱是追求稳定友谊的一大障碍。

examples.text: What's the appeal of a long, sweaty day in pursuit of an elusive, fast-moving wild animal?
examples.translation: 花上一整天汗流浃背地追逐一只难以捉摸、行动迅速的野生动物，究竟有什么吸引力？

examples.text: The return on the public investment in research depends upon wide distribution and ready access.
examples.translation: 公共科研投资的回报取决于广泛传播和便利获取。

examples.text: Making more investment in new vehicles.
examples.translation: 增加对新车辆的投资。

examples.text: The sheer volumes of investment in data centers and chips are not justified by consumers' willingness to part with their money.
examples.translation: 对数据中心和芯片如此巨额的投资，并不能由消费者的付费意愿来证明其合理性。

examples.translation: 作者或其雇主可能需要付费才能发表论文。

examples.text: You got what you paid for.
examples.translation: 一分钱一分货。

examples.text: Ecotourists might pay for lodging, birdwatching tours and meals.
examples.translation: 生态游客可能会为住宿、观鸟行程和餐饮付费。

examples.text: The grid must be sized for those moments, and someone must pay for it.
examples.translation: 电网必须按这些峰值时刻进行配置，而这笔成本总得有人承担。

examples.text: Ask for honest feedback from trusted friends, colleagues and professionals.
examples.translation: 向值得信任的朋友、同事和专业人士寻求坦诚反馈。

examples.text: Ask for an image of a DALL-E cat playing on a cell phone in an airplane.
examples.translation: 请求生成一张 DALL-E 猫在飞机上玩手机的图片。

examples.text: When asking for directions, do you prefer to be told where to go or to have a map sketched for you?
examples.translation: 问路时，你更喜欢别人直接告诉你怎么走，还是给你画一张地图？

examples.text: Scientific papers are the recordkeepers of progress in research.
examples.translation: 科学论文是记录研究进展的载体。

examples.text: Scientists have made a lot of progress in understanding what love is.
examples.translation: 科学家在理解爱情究竟是什么方面已经取得了很大进展。

examples.text: With the rapid progress in the economy, people's ideology is bound for change.
examples.translation: 随着经济快速发展，人们的思想观念必然会发生变化。

examples.text: Teachers are experimenting with different grading models, often on their own.
examples.translation: 教师们正在尝试不同的评分模式，而且往往是独自进行。

examples.text: Everyone is on their own path to some form of success.
examples.translation: 每个人都独自走在通往某种成功的道路上。

examples.text: They act on their own in rule-setting.
examples.translation: 他们在制定规则时独立行事。

examples.translation: 大多数睡眠惯性症状较轻，约 20 分钟后会自行消失。

examples.translation: 人类天生具备用四种主要方式应对挑战的能力。

examples.text: Our ability to constructively remember the past underlies our capacity to creatively imagine the future.
examples.translation: 我们以建设性方式回忆过去的能力，是创造性想象未来的基础。

examples.text: Human beings have the capacity to observe experience without being caught up in it.
examples.translation: 人类有能力观察自己的经历，而不被它裹挟。

examples.text: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their history embodies outdated privileges.
examples.translation: 尽管他们自称象征国家统一，但其历史体现着过时的特权。

examples.text: Both the wildlife park and zoo claimed to be operating for the benefit of the animals.
examples.translation: 野生动物园和动物园都声称自己的运营是为了动物的利益。

examples.text: People who claim to almost never remember their dreams do not seem to have obvious cognitive deficits.
examples.translation: 那些声称自己几乎从不记得梦境的人，似乎并没有明显的认知缺陷。

examples.translation: 尽管有一些相反的说法，笑大概对身体健康影响不大。

examples.translation: 国家的运作是记者关注的重要议题。

examples.text: The independence of standard-setters is essential to the proper functioning of capital markets.
examples.translation: 准则制定机构的独立性对资本市场正常运行至关重要。

examples.translation: 市场的运行建立在由潜在买家主导的灵活趋势之上。

examples.text: Laughter does cause short-term changes in the function of the heart and its blood vessels.
examples.translation: 笑确实会使心脏及其血管的功能发生短期变化。

examples.text: Repetition is partly a function of time constraints.
examples.translation: 重复在一定程度上是时间限制所造成的结果。

examples.translation: 那一天究竟何时到来仍是一个有争议的问题。

examples.text: These problems are not a matter of willpower.
examples.translation: 这些问题并不是意志力的问题。

examples.text: The problem with trade in the modern world isn't a matter of dollars and cents.
examples.translation: 现代世界的贸易问题并不只是钱的问题。

examples.text: It's only a matter of time before we learn just how profoundly we've underestimated them.
examples.translation: 我们迟早会再次意识到，自己对它们的低估有多么严重。

examples.text: The relationship between formal education and economic growth in poor countries is widely misunderstood.
examples.translation: 贫困国家正规教育与经济增长之间的关系被广泛误解。

examples.text: Continuing economic growth promotes the development of education.
examples.translation: 持续的经济增长会促进教育发展。

examples.text: Job creation and overall economic growth, which usually move in tandem, have diverged.
examples.translation: 通常同步变化的就业创造与总体经济增长如今出现了背离。

meanings.grammar: a balance between A and B

examples.text: The most successful NFL teams often find a balance between how much they pay their stars and their supporting players.
examples.translation: 最成功的 NFL 球队往往能在明星球员和辅助球员的薪资之间找到平衡。

examples.text: They need to strike a balance between getting paid and convincing followers they are still authentic.
examples.translation: 他们需要在赚钱与让粉丝相信自己仍然真实可信之间取得平衡。

examples.text: Strike a balance between intellectual pursuits and financial security.
examples.translation: 在精神追求与经济保障之间取得平衡。

examples.text: The framers of the Constitution envisioned law having authority apart from politics.
examples.translation: 宪法制定者设想法律应拥有独立于政治的权威。

examples.text: Our legal system was designed to set law apart from politics.
examples.translation: 我们的法律制度旨在把法律与政治区分开来。

examples.text: Apart from the AI creativity gap, great cooking involves a subtle understanding of ingredients.
examples.translation: 除了人工智能的创造力差距之外，优秀烹饪还需要对食材有细腻的理解。

examples.translation: 果断源自出色的想法。

examples.translation: sarcasm 一词的词源来自希腊语 sarkazein。

examples.translation: 意义感可以来自爱情、友谊和家庭。

examples.translation: 经济回报可以通过出售木材、非木材产品以及碳信用获得。

examples.text: [A] adapting to [B] deriving from [C] relying on [D] pointing at
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.translation: 在现代生活的一些领域，女性仍在追赶男性。

examples.translation: 当我们追上前面的朋友时，他们问起了那些红螃蟹。

examples.translation: 有关这些活动对年轻人具体益处的科学研究正在逐渐跟上。

examples.translation: 我们太容易陷入对别人会怎么看的反复思虑中。

examples.translation: 它表示将遵守“禁止追踪”请求。

examples.translation: 让我们放下高高在上的姿态，走出学术圈，与普通人建立联系。

examples.translation: 他们报告了自己的孤独感以及与他人建立联系的愿望。

examples.translation: 工作时缺乏人与人的联系，激发了员工与同事建立联系的强烈愿望。

examples.translation: 最终会从所有参赛者中产生一名获胜者。

examples.translation: 突破可能产生于意外、冲突以及强大的心理耐力。

examples.translation: 我生活中的许多焦虑都源于“如果……会怎样”这个问题。

examples.translation: 许多年轻人承担了大量自我教育的个人责任。

examples.translation: 最近这轮罢工的责任在工会一方。

examples.translation: 管理者承担起确保问题得到处理的责任。

examples.translation: 梦与情绪之间的联系在 Cartwright 诊所的患者身上表现出来。

examples.translation: 抵制行动可能使目标公司的声誉面临风险。

examples.translation: 近 1000 个岗位因数字化、人工智能和客户需求变化而面临风险。

examples.translation: 短期投资者可能妨碍企业投资长期研究。

examples.translation: 频繁卫星碰撞造成的碎片会使问题更加严重。

examples.text: Was this sad state of affairs caused by long hours or stressful work?
examples.translation: 这种糟糕的状况是由长时间工作造成的，还是由高压工作造成的？

examples.translation: 雇主长期以来一直看到招聘中学毕业生的优势。

examples.translation: 许多水下生物已经进化出利用声音传播特性的能力。

examples.text: Managers can take advantage of this by inviting team members to work a little below maximum capacity.
examples.translation: 管理者可以利用这一点，让团队成员以略低于最大能力的水平工作。

examples.translation: 主要是女性利用了这些休假政策。

examples.translation: 男性和女性面对压力时会表现出不同倾向。

examples.text: Faced with the loss of thousands of homes and an affordability crisis, lawmakers agreed on limited reforms.
examples.translation: 面对数千套住房损失和日益严重的可负担性危机，立法者同意进行有限改革。

examples.text: Faced with high teacher turnover and declining student enrollment, Westwood's leaders decided to try something different.
examples.translation: 面对教师高流失率和学生人数下降，Westwood 的领导者决定尝试不同做法。

meanings.text: 在……存在或出现的情况下

examples.translation: 我感受到的不仅仅是没有光。

examples.translation: 视杆细胞只需接触相对少量的光子就能被激活。

examples.translation: 她经常被迫通过加班来补做工作。

examples.translation: 匿名性是自由贸易悖论的第二个根本原因。

examples.translation: 吃饭时放慢速度，能让我们有更多时间感受到饱腹信号。

examples.translation: 试着通过深呼吸让心率慢下来。

examples.translation: 考虑用真正符合你优先事项的东西来取代它们。

examples.translation: 这把室内空气质量与能源政策、住房标准以及长期公共卫生成本联系起来。

examples.translation: 在人口快速老龄化的国家，孤独被视为一个严重的公共卫生问题。

examples.translation: 国会鼓励州级官员共享信息并与联邦同僚合作。

examples.translation: 大多数人愿意配合测试者学习一项新技能。

examples.translation: 在小社区长大的人可能更容易记住熟悉的面孔。

examples.translation: 现代交通信号灯也许起源于伦敦，但真正发展成熟于美国。

examples.translation: 记者报道并评论新闻。

examples.translation: PRH 拒绝就此问题发表评论。

examples.translation: 家人评论了他们所认为的她女儿注意力持续时间短的问题。

examples.translation: 国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展。

examples.translation: 因为跟不上别人而责备并催促自己，只会让事情更糟。

examples.translation: 为了维持家里的空气质量，额外过滤器的成本是值得的。

examples.translation: 我们对气味极其敏感。

examples.translation: 有些人对这两种花的气味都很敏感。

examples.translation: 对于不确定性也是一样：有些人就是对它更加敏感。

examples.translation: 居民们会帮助照看孩子，这种安排类似于共同育儿。

examples.translation: 只依赖最有价值球员，就像试图只靠一名球员得分一样。

examples.translation: 这种行为被认为是“太过人性化”的。

examples.translation: 奴隶制曾被视为一种特殊制度。

examples.translation: 慈善行为往往被视为超出职责要求的善举。

examples.translation: 让思绪自由游走，从长远看有助于提高专注力。

examples.translation: 心理干预有助于提升人们的幸福感。

examples.translation: 这种偏见会导致人们对失败路线投入越来越多。

examples.translation: 她表现出了许多可持续发展倡导者共有的理想主义。

examples.translation: 自由贸易倡导者必须在消费者与生产者之间建立联系。

examples.translation: “追随热情”原则的支持者认为，追随热情能够带来动力。

examples.text: They have so much more to cope with.
examples.translation: 他们需要应对的事情多得多。

examples.text: An apology can teach children to cope with discomfort.
examples.translation: 道歉可以教孩子如何应对不适感。

examples.text: Young people can develop a greater capacity to cope with stressful events.
examples.translation: 年轻人可以培养更强的压力事件应对能力。

examples.text: We are barely ever conscious of its abiding claims on us.
examples.translation: 我们几乎意识不到它长期以来对我们的影响。

examples.text: Millennials are the most conscious of style and personal branding.
examples.translation: 千禧一代最重视并最清楚地意识到风格和个人品牌。

examples.text: Users are forced to be more conscious of their role in passing along information.
examples.translation: 用户会被迫更加意识到自己在传播信息中的角色。

examples.text: Rulings would be more likely to be seen as separate from politics.
examples.translation: 裁决会更容易被视为独立于政治。

examples.text: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can be seen as one factor in its transformation.
examples.translation: 格拉斯哥担任欧洲文化之都的那一年，可被视为城市转型的一个因素。

examples.text: Dreams can be seen as a form of play that enhances cognitive flexibility.
examples.translation: 梦可以被视为一种增强认知灵活性的游戏形式。

examples.translation: 一些大一新生在过渡到大学课程时会遇到困难。

examples.translation: 接着过渡到各种不同深浅的红色。

examples.translation: 转换状态并过渡到新事物往往很困难。

examples.translation: 我们基本已经走到了目前所能达到的极限。

examples.translation: 我开始尽可能深入地研究声音奇观背后的科学与文化。

examples.translation: 就这一点而言，它与幸福倡导者提出的方案有许多相似之处。

examples.translation: 有关部门建议人们提前三小时到达。

examples.translation: 我应该能够提前把一切安排好。

examples.translation: 帮助他们想出提前学习和准备的方法。

examples.translation: 说话更快或声音更大的一方很容易开始占用更多发言时间。

examples.translation: 它们占用的自然空间远少于自然景观。

examples.translation: 越来越多的研究表明，频繁但低强度的火灾会让许多生态系统更健康。

examples.translation: 越来越多的研究显示，乐观心态确实有益。

examples.translation: 这些发现进一步支持了越来越多有关肌肉与免疫健康的证据。

examples.translation: 毕业生除本科债务之外，还背负着 10 万美元债务。

examples.translation: 该法案使得在新的州级税费之外再征地方税成为可能。

examples.translation: 除此之外，被忽视的作物还是最具气候韧性的作物之一。

examples.translation: 在所有这些问题之外，还没有确凿证据表明这份契约曾经存在。

examples.translation: 每只猴子都能看到另一只猴子用石头换来了什么。

examples.translation: 美国人愿意忍受耗时的安检程序，以换取更高的安全性。

examples.translation: 以为别人开方便之门来换取好处，是令人反感的。

examples.translation: 尤其是对黄石地区价值的认识，很大程度上来自生动的照片。

examples.translation: 与此同时，法院驳回了 FCC 试图阻止所有州级规则的做法。

examples.translation: 有些人可以等待合适的工作，而不必在此期间担心学生贷款。

examples.translation: 他试图说明文化各方面如何在社会演进中共同变化。

examples.translation: 我们无法摆脱自身独特生活经历这一背景。

examples.translation: 任何展品所处的语境都比其年代更重要。

examples.translation: 采取行动的理由因此变得更加明确。

examples.translation: 这个项目从经济和商业角度论证了再造林的必要性。

examples.translation: 我们不得不考虑，我们是否正在培养能够保障这种能力的力量。
