examples.text: Some regard CSR policies as a waste of shareholders' money.
examples.translation: 有些人把企业社会责任政策视为浪费股东的钱。

examples.text: The waste of workday hours can feel insulting.
examples.translation: 工作时间被白白浪费，会让员工觉得难以接受。

examples.text: [D] waste of electricity in their projects.
examples.translation: 完形填空

meanings.text: 弄清楚如何；想出怎样去……
meanings.grammar: figure out how to do sth.

examples.text: Artists are trying to figure out how to tackle or mitigate this.
examples.translation: 艺术家们正在设法弄清如何应对或缓解这个问题。

examples.text: The key to adjusting is figuring out how to redesign our economic systems.
examples.translation: 适应变化的关键在于弄清如何重新设计我们的经济体系。

examples.text: It would be nice to figure out how to keep those emotions contained.
examples.translation: 如果能弄清楚如何控制这些情绪就好了。

examples.text: Teenagers desire nothing more than fitting in.
examples.translation: 青少年最渴望的往往就是融入群体。

examples.text: I struggle to fit in with the rest of the world's circadian rhythm.
examples.translation: 我很难让自己的作息适应其他人的昼夜节律。

examples.text: They could not all fit in his car.
examples.translation: 它们无法全部装进他的车里。

examples.text: What if Peretti were in charge at the Times?
examples.translation: 如果由 Peretti 掌管《纽约时报》，会怎样？

examples.text: One result is an increase in the satisfaction that should come from being in charge.
examples.translation: 其中一个结果是，掌握主动权所带来的满足感会增加。

examples.text: A. Consulted someone in charge.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Short-termism is the desire for quick profits.
examples.translation: 短期主义就是对快速获利的追求。

examples.text: The desire for happiness is natural and normal.
examples.translation: 对幸福的渴望是自然且正常的。

examples.text: A degree of inbuilt lethargy and the desire for short cuts makes a lot of sense.
examples.translation: 某种程度的天生惰性以及走捷径的愿望，其实是可以理解的。

meanings.text: 要求……的压力；推动……的压力

senses.gloss: 要求……的压力；推动……的压力

examples.text: Public-health campaigns fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits.
examples.translation: 公共卫生宣传未能有效利用同伴压力来推动健康习惯。

examples.text: There is pressure for change from within the profession.
examples.translation: 行业内部存在要求变革的压力。

examples.text: Voluntary standards rely more on peer pressure for enforcement.
examples.translation: 这些自愿标准更多依靠同伴压力来促使执行。

examples.text: It is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images.
examples.translation: 它正试图为模特和时尚图片制定自愿标准。

examples.text: He is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils.
examples.translation: 他反对修改面向青春期前学生的科学课程标准。

examples.text: The standard for English in British newsreels differs greatly from the standard found on American national news broadcasts today.
examples.translation: 英国新闻影片中的英语标准与今天美国全国新闻广播中的标准差异很大。

meanings.text: 整个；一般而言；总体上的

examples.text: Children learn to explore their immediate world and the world at large.
examples.translation: 孩子们学会探索身边的世界以及更广阔的世界。

examples.text: [A] at first [B] at all [C] at large [D] at times
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: The muddled motivations can be seen at large tech firms like Amazon.
examples.translation: 其他

examples.text: The demand for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not previously considered university.
examples.translation: 进入高等教育的需求扩展到了此前从未考虑上大学的群体和社会阶层。

examples.text: The elevated risk extended to respiratory infections, urinary tract infections and sepsis.
examples.translation: 这种升高的风险还波及呼吸道感染、尿路感染和败血症。

examples.text: [A] coped with [B] consisted of [C] hinted at [D] extended to
examples.translation: 完形填空

meanings.text: 与……挂钩；与……紧密相关；与……联系在一起

examples.text: A substantial part of executive pay is now tied to performance.
examples.translation: 如今，高管薪酬中相当大的一部分与业绩挂钩。

examples.text: Most respondents saw their identity tied to their homeland.
examples.translation: 大多数受访者认为自己的身份认同与故乡紧密相连。

examples.text: This perspective is more strongly tied to relationship satisfaction for women.
examples.translation: 对女性来说，这种观点与关系满意度之间的联系更强。

meanings.text: 部分由于；部分由……造成或推动

examples.text: They have been spurred in part by DNA evidence made available in 1998.
examples.translation: 这些变化部分是受到 1998 年公布的 DNA 证据推动的。

examples.text: The decline was aided in part by support for a 2020 federal law.
examples.translation: 这种下降部分得益于对 2020 年一项联邦法律的支持。

examples.text: The positive effect might be explained in part by air pollution or the lack of it.
examples.translation: 这种积极效果在一定程度上可能由空气污染状况来解释。

examples.text: Measuring crops by nutrition instead of yield is at the heart of the forgotten foods enterprise.
examples.translation: 用营养价值而非产量衡量作物，是“被遗忘食物”事业的核心。

examples.text: The battle for equity is at the heart of these vital conversations.
examples.translation: 争取公平正是这些重要讨论的核心。

examples.text: Behavioral aspects lie at the heart of a significant change initiative.
examples.translation: 行为层面的因素处于重大变革计划的核心。

meanings.text: 无论如何；不管怎样；总之

examples.text: Workers tend to be diligent for the first few days of the week in any case.
examples.translation: 无论如何，员工在一周最初几天通常都会比较勤奋。

examples.text: In any case it must have something to do with the soul of the human being.
examples.translation: 无论如何，在我看来，它一定与人的灵魂有关。

examples.text: Workers are in any case likely to be forgiving.
examples.translation: 不管怎样，员工大概都会比较宽容。

examples.text: Regulators will act if firms fail to provide adequate data security.
examples.translation: 如果企业未能提供充分的数据安全保障，监管机构将采取行动。

examples.text: The findings do not suggest that companion animals fail to provide benefits.
examples.translation: 这些发现并不意味着伴侣动物无法提供益处。

examples.text: [C] have failed to provide an adequate service.
examples.translation: 完形填空

meanings.grammar: make it possible for sb. to do sth.

examples.text: Digital technology makes it possible for businesses to innovate restaurant models.
examples.translation: 数字技术使企业能够创新餐厅经营模式。

examples.text: Mass production of cars made it possible for ordinary people to buy them.
examples.translation: 汽车的大规模生产使普通人也能买得起汽车。

examples.text: Mobile phones and social media make it possible for corporations to target our attention at every moment.
examples.translation: 手机和社交媒体使企业能够时时刻刻精准争夺我们的注意力。

examples.text: There have been fewer street fights since the arrival of the wireless.
examples.translation: 自无线广播出现以来，街头斗殴变少了。

examples.text: The parallels have multiplied since the arrival of AI.
examples.translation: 自人工智能出现以来，这些相似之处越来越多。

meanings.grammar: in an effort to do sth.

examples.text: Some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions.
examples.translation: 一些科学家希望缩减研究规模，以努力减少碳排放。

examples.text: Employees helped their coworkers in an effort to reconnect.
examples.translation: 员工为了重新建立联系而帮助同事。

examples.text: In an effort to combat the side effects of MRS, researchers developed interventions.
examples.translation: 为了应对 MRS 的副作用，研究人员制定了相应干预措施。

examples.text: The state wants to step up the fight against counterfeit versions.
examples.translation: 该州希望加大打击假冒产品的力度。

examples.text: Nuclear is essential to the fight against the climate crisis.
examples.translation: 核能对于应对气候危机至关重要。

examples.text: [A] played a part in the fight against illegal file-sharing.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: The infant responds by vocalizing, smiling back, and pointing at things in the room.
examples.translation: 婴儿会通过发声、回以微笑以及指着房间里的东西来回应。

examples.text: [A] adapting to [B] deriving from [C] relying on [D] pointing at
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: There's often a point at which adding star players results in diminishing returns.
examples.translation: 其他

examples.text: The roots of today's food industry stretch back to 19th-century innovations.
examples.translation: 今天食品工业的根源可追溯到 19 世纪的创新。

examples.text: The roots of these connotations about local foods can run deep.
examples.translation: 围绕本地食品的这些含义，其根源可能非常深。

examples.text: At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence about how to decide who is valuable.
examples.translation: 势利的根源在于缺乏判断谁有价值的想象力和信心。

examples.text: Extroverted employees engaged in dynamic tones of voice.
examples.translation: 外向型员工更常使用富有变化的语气。

examples.text: An AI may respond to every nuance of emotion, even tone of voice.
examples.translation: 人工智能可能会对每一种细微情绪，甚至说话语气作出回应。

examples.text: Sarcasm is mostly understood through tone of voice.
examples.translation: 讽刺主要通过说话语气来理解。

examples.text: The casino intentionally worked to lure him to engage in conduct against his will.
examples.translation: 赌场被指故意诱使他从事违背自身意愿的行为。

examples.text: It is much better to get the unhappy person to engage in an activity that she likes.
examples.translation: 更好的办法是让不开心的人参与她喜欢的活动。

examples.text: People express a greater desire to engage in social activities after thinking about a gratifying experience.
examples.translation: 人们回想令人满足的经历后，会表现出更强的参与社交活动的愿望。

meanings.text: 可能造成；有……危险；威胁要

examples.text: A new problem threatens to earn bosses and boards nasty headlines.
examples.translation: 一个新问题可能会让企业高管和董事会陷入负面新闻。

examples.text: Automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income.
examples.translation: 自动化可能会扩大资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距。

examples.text: The growth of professional actors was threatening to make the drama popular.
examples.translation: 职业演员阶层的增长正使戏剧有走向大众化的趋势。

meanings.text: 支持……的理由；主张……的依据

examples.text: The case for concern has three parts.
examples.translation: 认为应当担忧的理由有三个方面。

examples.text: The case for action becomes much clearer.
examples.translation: 采取行动的理由因此变得更加明确。

examples.text: That's the case for my friend Juna Gjata.
examples.translation: 其他

meanings.text: 在……方面的进步；进展；发展

examples.text: Advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels to react to trends more quickly.
examples.translation: 技术进步使大众品牌能够更快地响应潮流。

examples.text: Advances in artificial intelligence are rapidly changing every aspect of human life.
examples.translation: 人工智能的进步正迅速改变人类生活的方方面面。

examples.text: Advances in AI will almost certainly reshape creative work.
examples.translation: 人工智能的发展几乎必然会重塑创意工作。

meanings.text: 在……中的结果；……方面的结果

examples.text: People may fear negative outcomes in life.
examples.translation: 人们可能会害怕生活中的负面结果。

examples.text: We often ascribe certain brain changes to negative outcomes in adulthood or later life.
examples.translation: 我们常把某些大脑变化归因于成年期或晚年出现的负面结果。

examples.text: A different method may achieve the same outcomes in a more enjoyable manner.
examples.translation: 另一种方法可能以更愉快的方式达到相同结果。

meanings.text: 陷入；落入；进入某种状态

examples.text: Your first instinct is to fall into permanent dependency.
examples.translation: 你的第一反应可能是陷入永久依赖。

examples.text: It's easy to fall into the belief that there's a 'good' or 'bad' way for a brain to be structured.
examples.translation: 人很容易陷入这样一种想法：大脑结构存在所谓“好”或“坏”的方式。

examples.text: There's a habit that many perfectionists tend to fall into when they try to establish a behavior change.
examples.translation: 许多完美主义者在尝试改变行为时，往往会陷入一种特定习惯。

examples.text: On the contrary, constraints on improving productivity explain why education isn't developing more quickly.
examples.translation: 恰恰相反，提高生产率所受到的限制解释了为什么教育发展得不够快。

examples.text: On the contrary, the desire for happiness is natural and normal.
examples.translation: 相反，对幸福的渴望是自然且正常的。

examples.text: On the contrary, decades of research show that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as comparable male politicians.
examples.translation: 恰恰相反，几十年的研究表明，女性候选人的筹款能力和胜选概率与条件相近的男性政治人物相当。

examples.text: [G] Build Your Kids' Sense of Responsibility.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: [C] have a strong sense of responsibility.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: [A] enhance bankers' sense of responsibility.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Many apathetic people just don't find it sufficiently rewarding to take action.
examples.translation: 许多冷漠的人只是觉得采取行动不够值得。

examples.text: The situation led employees to take action to reconnect.
examples.translation: 这种情况促使员工采取行动重新建立联系。

examples.text: [C] Congress needs to take action to ensure net neutrality.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: We spoke to several experts to find out why they don't recommend this style of boot.
examples.translation: 我们采访了几位专家，以弄清他们为什么不推荐这种靴子。

examples.text: Researchers are trying to find out how higher temperatures and CO2 levels affect alternative crops.
examples.translation: 研究人员正试图弄清更高温度和二氧化碳水平如何影响替代作物。

examples.text: To find out, Kim's team had participants watch a five-minute clip.
examples.translation: 为了弄清这一点，Kim 的团队让参与者观看了一段五分钟的视频。

meanings.text: 使我们能够；让我们可以

senses.gloss: 使我们能够；让我们可以

examples.text: This might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose.
examples.translation: 这或许能让我们理解复杂文化行为是如何产生的。

examples.text: The longitudinal nature of the data enables us to examine how team dynamics shift over time.
examples.translation: 这些纵向数据使我们能够考察团队动态如何随时间变化。

examples.text: Technological advances enable us to make more efficient use of the assets we already have.
examples.translation: 技术进步使我们能够更高效地利用已有资产。

examples.text: We now live in an age of plastic.
examples.translation: 我们如今生活在一个塑料时代。

examples.text: Can it be right or acceptable that in an age of 24/7 communication you submit an article and wait months for feedback?
examples.translation: 在一个全天候通信的时代，投稿后还要等上数月才能得到反馈，这真的合理或可以接受吗？

examples.text: In an age where career progression may lead us into new sectors, it is ever more important to challenge our sense of self.
examples.translation: 在职业发展可能把我们带入全新领域的时代，重新审视自我认知变得愈发重要。

examples.text: Conservative or classical liberal ideas are portrayed as falling outside the boundaries of legitimate intellectual investigation.
examples.translation: 保守主义或古典自由主义观点被描绘成处于正当学术研究范围之外。

examples.text: They're pushing the boundaries of what humans eat by growing and processing so-called 'alternative' crops.
examples.translation: 他们通过种植和加工所谓“替代性”作物，不断拓展人类饮食的边界。

examples.text: These groups are pushing the boundary of how to revive forest cover.
examples.translation: 这些团体正在不断探索森林覆盖恢复方式的边界。

examples.text: Believing generative AI will eventually produce enough revenue relies on telling dramatic stories about the scale of the transformation under way.
examples.translation: 认为生成式人工智能最终会产生足够收入，需要建立在对当前转型规模的宏大叙事之上。

examples.text: The 4,000 dead birds are laid out in a display showing the scale of the damage.
examples.translation: 收集到的 4000 只死鸟被陈列出来，以展示破坏的严重程度。

examples.text: I knew there was hunting going on, but the scale of this is just disgusting.
examples.translation: 我知道存在捕猎行为，但其规模之大令人作呕。

examples.text: The recent slowdown in the number of international students is likely to continue.
examples.translation: 国际学生人数最近出现的增长放缓很可能会持续。

examples.text: Students were also more likely to continue with languages at GCSE.
examples.translation: 学生也更有可能在 GCSE 阶段继续学习语言。

examples.text: Retailers were likely to continue offering discounts past the typical winter sale period.
examples.translation: 零售商很可能会在通常的冬季促销期结束后继续提供折扣。

examples.text: The information on TikTok doesn't always tell you the full story.
examples.translation: TikTok 上的信息并不总能告诉你事情的全貌。

examples.text: Keeping sensitive information on these devices is increasingly a requirement of normal life.
examples.translation: 把敏感信息存储在这些设备上，越来越成为日常生活中的常见需要。

examples.text: [D] the inconvenience of storing information on analog devices.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Knowing that mental health is always available allows us to slow down to the moment and live life happily.
examples.translation: 知道心理健康始终可以重新获得，能让我们慢下来，专注当下并更快乐地生活。

examples.text: The digestive system tends to slow down after 20 minutes of sleep.
examples.translation: 入睡约 20 分钟后，消化系统往往会减慢运行。

examples.text: Try to slow down your heart rate by taking deep breaths.
examples.translation: 试着通过深呼吸让心率慢下来。

meanings.text: 在许多方面；从很多角度看

examples.text: It resembled European society in many ways, but had a character that was distinctly American.
examples.translation: 它在许多方面与欧洲社会相似，却具有鲜明的美国特色。

examples.text: This mistaken view of arguments causes profound problems and in many ways misses the point of arguing.
examples.translation: 这种对争论的错误理解会造成严重问题，而且在很多方面偏离了争论本来的意义。

examples.text: It has made it easier to get by, but in many ways harder to truly succeed.
examples.translation: 它让勉强应付生活变得更容易，却在很多方面让真正取得成功变得更难。

examples.text: The U.S. workforce was derided as poorly educated and one of the primary causes of poor U.S. economic performance.
examples.translation: 美国劳动力曾因教育水平低而受到批评，并被认为是美国经济表现不佳的主要原因之一。

examples.text: Missing 10% of school days in a year is a primary cause of low academic achievement.
examples.translation: 一年缺勤达到上课日的 10%，是学业成绩低下的一个主要原因。

examples.text: C. It is the primary cause of inequitable distribution of wealth.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: It is in conflict with the suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain work together.
examples.translation: 这与“大脑左右半球协同工作”的说法相冲突。

examples.text: [A] The Middle Class on the Alert [B] The Middle Class on the Cliff [C] The Middle Class in Conflict [D] The Middle Class in Ruins
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Karina Schumann, an associate professor of social psychology who specializes in conflict resolution, told me.
examples.translation: 其他

meanings.text: 与……相比；与……形成对比；不同于

examples.text: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed on rules and sanctions regarding models.
examples.translation: 与法国的做法不同，丹麦时尚业就模特的年龄、健康等方面达成了规则和处罚措施。

examples.text: Productive debates might be possible, in contrast to the familiar mutual condemnation in discussing other issues.
examples.translation: 与讨论其他问题时常见的相互谴责不同，这一议题上或许能够展开富有成效的辩论。

examples.text: [A] On the basis of [B] At the cost of [C] In addition to [D] In contrast to
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: Distractions prevent us from fully tasting or enjoying what we are eating.
examples.translation: 干扰会使我们无法充分品尝或享受正在吃的食物。

examples.text: Behavioral inertia prevents us from implementing new changes, like eating a healthy diet or exercising.
examples.translation: 行为惰性会阻碍我们落实新的改变，例如健康饮食或锻炼。

examples.text: A. It prevents us from making arbitrary judgments about others.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: He was surprised to find a record of repeated blazes dating back hundreds of years.
examples.translation: 他惊讶地发现了可追溯到数百年前的反复火灾记录。

examples.text: Journal entries should provide not only a record of what happened but how we reacted emotionally.
examples.translation: 日记条目不仅应记录发生了什么，也应记录我们的情绪反应。

examples.text: The industry has a record of launching new products that cater to weight-watching consumers.
examples.translation: 这个行业历来会推出迎合控制体重消费者的新产品。

senses.gloss: 论文或研究结果的发表；发布

examples.text: This could change the traditional peer-review process, at least for the publication of papers.
examples.translation: 这可能改变传统的同行评审流程，至少会影响论文发表这一环节。

examples.text: Even with the publication of the results, the question remained.
examples.translation: 即使研究结果已经发表，这个问题仍然存在。

examples.text: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of Frankenstein.
examples.translation: 今年正值《弗兰肯斯坦》出版两百周年。

examples.text: A lot of science journalism values novelty over utility, reporting on studies that turn out to be more likely to fail replication.
examples.translation: 许多科学新闻更重视新奇性而非实用性，报道的研究后来往往更难被重复验证。

examples.text: Media outlets excitedly reported on a paper.
examples.translation: 媒体曾兴奋地报道一篇论文。

examples.text: While reporting on parenting issues, I've spoken with dozens of child psychologists and researchers.
examples.translation: 在报道育儿问题的几年里，我采访过数十位儿童心理学家和研究人员。

examples.text: The study looked at how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes.
examples.translation: 这项研究考察了全国各州公立学校如何在科学课中讲授气候变化。

examples.text: We can improve recruiting, training, and retention strategies for schools across the country.
examples.translation: 我们可以改进全国各地学校的教师招聘、培训和留任策略。

examples.text: Offered by libraries across the country, these programs are wonderful examples of scholar-facilitated learning.
examples.translation: 这些项目由全国各地图书馆提供，是学者引导型学习的优秀范例。

examples.text: In theory, the outcome of an applicant should not depend on the few others randomly selected for interview during the same day.
examples.translation: 理论上，一名申请者的结果不应取决于当天随机被选来一起面试的其他几个人。

examples.text: In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced.
examples.translation: 在互联网时代，至少从理论上说，这一比例可以大幅降低。

examples.text: [A] In theory [B] In time [C] Above all [D] For example
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: These programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
examples.translation: 这些项目旨在减少不平等并打破贫困循环。

examples.text: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats and digital information?
examples.translation: 你是否思考过无形格式和数字信息的生命周期？

examples.text: D. Vicious cycles of detachment.
examples.translation: 完形填空

examples.text: We must concentrate more on coproductions, the exchange of news, documentary services and training.
examples.translation: 我们必须更加重视联合制作、新闻交流、纪录片服务和培训。

examples.text: Through the exchange of letters, you get to practice your writing skills and provide feedback to each other.
examples.translation: 通过书信往来，你不仅能练习写作，还可以彼此提供反馈。

examples.text: Bonds of friendship have been strengthened and symbolized through the exchange of gifts.
examples.translation: 长期以来，友谊纽带一直通过互赠礼物得到加强和体现。

examples.text: New parents are forced to jump out of bed at the crack of dawn.
examples.translation: 新手父母常常不得不在天刚亮时就从床上起来。

examples.text: When training is variable, learners are forced to actively reconstruct their memories.
examples.translation: 当训练具有变化性时，学习者会被迫主动重建记忆。

examples.text: If you don't believe we can do it, and you care about the climate, you are forced to think about something like nuclear.
examples.translation: 如果你不相信我们能靠现有方式解决问题，同时又关心气候，那么你就不得不考虑核能之类的选择。

examples.text: As a result of this leader's zero-sum mindset against other teams, he developed a negative reputation across the company.
examples.translation: 由于这名领导者对其他团队抱有零和思维，他在全公司形成了负面声誉。

examples.text: The tree fell, rumor has it, as a result of a severe windstorm and/or because its roots had rotted.
examples.translation: 据传，这棵树因猛烈风暴和/或根部腐烂而倒下。

examples.text: [D] as a result of pressure on government.
examples.translation: 完形填空
